title: 3 easy fixes for your resume ✍️
description:
Just a reminder that even the simplest achievement can have impact if you frame it the right way.

If you’re struggling to get interviews using your current resume, take a look at each bullet point achievement and ask yourself:

:bulb:Are you just listing out past responsibilities, or are you showing the “so what”—the result of what you achieved in this role?

:bulb:Is there a metric you can include here? (How many team members you managed, roughly how much you increased growth, etc.)

:bulb: Are you using a strong action verb to start the achievement? (Avoid “assisted with” or “responsible for” and choose more powerful words instead!)

If you want a hand strengthening your achievements, the Teal Resume Builder has built-in tools for just that. #resumebuilder #resume #resumetips
